comment: Render produces the pure parts: ai-plugin.json is rendered in full (URL-derived namespace + auth reference_id via the mcpNamespace/mcpAuthRef expr functions + the unconditional dynamic-discovery RemoteMCPServer runtime), and m365agents.yml is the v1.12 skeleton without the auth step. Auth wiring is post-render injection because it includes endpoint discovery, DCR fallback, the v1.13 schema bump, and explicit static credential environment references. The persist step writes the registration-result placeholder plus collected static credentials through the runtime environment writer, which isolates SECRET_* values. The final feature-gated step optionally applies the sensitivity label.

steps.comment: Guards the create contract: the target dir has no colliding files so render writes every file. Possibly redundant if the engine already guarantees create scaffolds into a fresh empty dir — pending alignment with the v4 engine; not from PR #16067.
